entities.summary: Emmanuel "Manny" Noveen Malhotra is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He is the head coach of the Abbotsford Canucks of the American Hockey League (AHL), and was previously an assistant coach in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Vancouver Canucks and Toronto Maple Leafs.
